title: Round 2: minimal, with a technical edge
question: Three directions built on rauno.me, teenage.engineering and railway.com. In each, scrolling shows the journey of one product being built and ends in email + LinkedIn + kevinkrs.com. Pick one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: The Drawing Sheet
options.lineage: engineering drawing sheets and exploded assembly views; closest to teenage.engineering
options.thesis: One product drawn as a thin-line exploded view: each scroll step slides in the next layer, from wireframe to ML, with leader lines and small callouts.
materials: one orange for the part being added
title block with name and contact
options.viewport: A light grey sheet with a fine border. Left third: the headline in small, tight type and the contact action. Right two thirds: the isometric stack with only the wireframe plate drawn and ghost outlines of the layers to come. Bottom right: a title block reading Agency of One, Kevin Kraus, sheet 1 of 6.
options.risk: Isometric line drawings are a known look; it stays special only if the linework is drawn with real care.

options.label: The Canvas
options.lineage: node canvases with live connections; closest to railway.com
options.thesis: One dotted canvas the camera travels across: a sketch becomes a screen, the screen gets a server, and requests start running along the lines as dots.
options.viewport: A dark dotted canvas fills the viewport. Top left: the headline in small type with the contact action under it. Centre: a single node, a hand-drawn wireframe, with one dashed line leaving the right edge toward the next node off screen.
options.risk: Dark canvas with one bright accent is the look most developer sites already have.

options.label: One Figure
options.lineage: bare text-first personal sites with one crafted interactive detail; closest to rauno.me
options.thesis: A narrow column of short sentences tells the journey, and one small live figure beside it grows from a box into a running system as you read.
options.viewport: Almost empty near-white page. A 520px text column left of centre: A/1 mark, the headline at modest size, one sentence, the contact links. To its right, a 360px sticky figure: one outlined rectangle with a blinking cursor. Thin tick marks down the far left edge show the six stages.
options.risk: The quietest of the three; if the figure is not excellent the page reads as a plain text site.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The developer-tool landing page at the level of linear.app, vercel.com and railway.com: dark ground, centred headline, a node diagram that animates on scroll.
canonCard.viewport: Centred headline and action over a live architecture diagram.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every developer-tool site by design.
